title: Der alte Trapper
summary: "Der alte Trapper" by James Fenimore Cooper is a novel published in 1827. It follows the legendary frontiersman Natty Bumppo, now an elderly trapper in his final year, as he ventures onto the vast American prairies. When he encounters a family of settlers and a young captain searching for his kidnapped bride, the aging hero must use his wilderness wisdom one last time. Amid conflicts with Sioux warriors, a noble Pawnee chief, and dangerous betrayals, Natty faces his greatest challenge: finding peace in a vanishing frontier.
